title: 英國一號高速鐵路~High Speed 1
focus: 跨海高速接線都市隧道與國際轉乘~International high speed links urban tunnels and interchange
summary: 以英國一號高速鐵路分期通達倫敦的背景，建立國際列車與城市終端銜接的教學系統。案例把隧道壓力、旅客服務排隊、曲線噪音和道岔占用一起考慮，要求區分列車通過能力與邊境或航廈式服務的處理能力。~Use the phased arrival of High Speed 1 into London to construct a teaching system linking international trains to an urban terminal. Consider tunnel pressure, passenger-processing queues, curve noise and switch occupation together. Distinguish railway throughput from the capacity of border-style passenger processing, and trace how a delayed batch of passengers changes boarding and departure readiness.
example: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 travel=7.647059 s；單元 2 得 displacement_flow=187.2 m^3/s；單元 3 得 combined=72.4554 dB。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 length 的擾動測試，結果改為 8.411765 s；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以英國一號高速鐵路分期通達倫敦的背景，建立國際列車與城市終端銜接的教學系統。案例把隧道壓力、旅客服務排隊、曲線噪音和道岔占用一起考慮，要求區分列車通過能力與邊境或航廈式服務的處理能力。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。~Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives travel=7.647059 s; unit 2 gives displacement_flow=187.2 m^3/s; unit 3 gives combined=72.4554 dB. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing length in the first unit changes its result to 8.411765 s. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the phased arrival of High Speed 1 into London to construct a teaching system linking international trains to an urban terminal. Consider tunnel pressure, passenger-processing queues, curve noise and switch occupation together. Distinguish railway throughput from the capacity of border-style passenger processing, and trace how a delayed batch of passengers changes boarding and departure readiness. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
history: 公開工程與出版時間線：2003 年：英國一號高速鐵路第一階段路段開通；2007 年：英國一號高速鐵路第二階段通達倫敦終端。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以英國一號高速鐵路分期通達倫敦的背景，建立國際列車與城市終端銜接的教學系統。案例把隧道壓力、旅客服務排隊、曲線噪音和道岔占用一起考慮，要求區分列車通過能力與邊境或航廈式服務的處理能力。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。~Public engineering and publication chronology: 2003: The first phase of High Speed 1 opened; 2007: The second phase of High Speed 1 opened to its London terminal. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the phased arrival of High Speed 1 into London to construct a teaching system linking international trains to an urban terminal. Consider tunnel pressure, passenger-processing queues, curve noise and switch occupation together. Distinguish railway throughput from the capacity of border-style passenger processing, and trace how a delayed batch of passengers changes boarding and departure readiness. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

units.anchor: 隧道壓力波傳遞~Tunnel pressure-wave travel
units.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞~Tunnel pressure-wave travel
units.mechanism: 列車鼻部入隧道產生壓縮擾動，壓力波以接近音速傳播而不是跟著列車速度前進。入口緩衝設計影響波形上升率，波到達出口的時間與車身到達時間屬不同問題，須分開建立量測觸發。 波傳時間由傳播距離除以聲速決定，與列車走完整段的時間不同。此式只預測到達時序而不預測波幅；洞口形狀、列車頭型和反射決定的壓力變化須用其他流動模型。 在連續隧道與洞口測點之間比較聲波傳播時間和列車通過時間，另列波幅問題。~A train nose entering a tunnel creates a compression disturbance whose propagation speed is close to acoustic speed rather than train speed. Entrance treatments affect the rise of the waveform. Wave arrival and train arrival are different events and require separate measurement triggers. Wave travel time is propagation distance divided by sound speed, not the time for the train to traverse the section. This expression predicts arrival timing, not amplitude. Portal geometry, train-nose shape and reflections require additional flow models to predict pressure changes. Compare acoustic travel time with train-passage time between tunnel and portal sensors, treating wave amplitude as a separate problem.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2600 m; sound=340 m/s；計算：travel=length/sound=7.647059 s。敏感度：length 單獨增加百分之十至 2860 m，其餘固定，結果為 8.411765 s。模型邊界：一維線性聲學且音速均勻；不預測波幅、微壓波峰值或反射耗散。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2600 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.647059 s. Sensitivity: length, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2860 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.411765 s. Model boundary: One-dimensional linear acoustics with uniform sound speed; amplitude, micro-pressure-wave peaks and reflection losses are not predicted.
units.verify: 在入口與出口配置同步壓力計，用互相關估計傳遞時間，並用溫度估算音速；列車里程觸發另存一條通道。 在洞口與洞內配置同步壓力測點，對照列車頭部通過時刻，分辨首波與後續反射。~Use synchronised pressure sensors at both portals, estimate travel time by cross-correlation and sound speed from temperature, and retain train-position triggering separately. Synchronise pressure sensors at the portal and inside the tunnel with nose-passage time, distinguishing the first wave from later reflections.
units.failure: 時間戳誤差會被誤認為波速變化；長隧道的反射波與多車事件也可能讓互相關找到錯誤的峰。 單點峰值不足以判別首波，須檢查測點間傳遞時差。~Timestamp error can imitate a wave-speed change, while reflected waves and multiple train events can make cross-correlation select the wrong peak. A single peak cannot identify the first wave; inspect propagation delay between sensors.
units.misconception: 隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口~A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train.
units.practice: 比較壓力波與列車兩種到達時間，加入一次端部反射畫出事件圖，說明單一延遲量無法判斷出口微壓波是否超標。 再以本單元 length 的對照值重算 travel，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare wave and train arrival times, add one end reflection to the event diagram, and explain why travel time alone cannot establish compliance of portal micro-pressure waves. Also recalculate travel for the alternative length value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 列車活塞流量與堵塞比~Train piston flow and blockage ratio
units.title: 列車活塞流量與堵塞比~Train piston flow and blockage ratio
units.mechanism: 列車進入受限斷面時排擠空氣，列車截面乘速度提供幾何排量的量級。實際空氣可經車旁間隙、通風井和相鄰隧道分流，因此幾何排量不是某一通風井的實測流量。 列車排開體積的模型首先遵守連續方程，但洩漏、車站開口與可壓縮效應會改變實際流場。應明確使用剩餘通流面積，不能用整個隧道面積忽略車體阻塞。 把列車排開體積與有效通風截面連結，檢查短時空氣流量。~A train displaces air in a confined section, and frontal area times speed gives the geometric displacement scale. Air divides through the annular gap, shafts and adjoining tunnels. Geometric displacement therefore does not equal measured flow through a particular ventilation shaft. A displaced-volume model first follows continuity, but leakage, station openings and compressibility alter the actual field. Use the remaining flow area explicitly rather than the whole tunnel area while ignoring train blockage. Connect displaced train volume to effective ventilation area and inspect transient airflow.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：train_area=9.36 m^2; speed=20 m/s；計算：displacement_flow=train_area*speed=187.2 m^3/s。敏感度：train_area 單獨增加百分之十至 10.296 m^2，其餘固定，結果為 205.92 m^3/s。模型邊界：不可壓縮幾何排量；未求壓差、流路分配與空氣壓縮。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: train_area=9.36 m^2; speed=20 m/s; calculation: displacement_flow=train_area*speed=187.2 m^3/s. Sensitivity: train_area, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 10.296 m^2, with all other inputs fixed, gives 205.92 m^3/s. Model boundary: Incompressible geometric displacement; pressure difference, path splitting and compressibility are not solved.
units.verify: 以列車位置同步觸發各風井和月台風速量測，檢查流量方向與時間差，避免把瞬時尖峰當成持續換氣能力。 在列車通過前後同步量測風速、壓力及位置，以多點截面平均避免局部噴流誤差。~Trigger shaft and platform air-velocity measurements from train position, inspect direction and delay, and avoid treating a brief peak as continuous ventilation capacity. Synchronise airflow, pressure and train position around passage, using a multipoint section average to avoid bias from local jets.
units.failure: 風井受阻時氣流可能轉移到月台，造成局部強風；單一風速計又可能量到回流區而低估主流。 局部風速尖峰不能當作整段平均流量，須核對截面分布。~A blocked shaft can redirect flow toward the platform and create local gusts; one anemometer inside a recirculation region may underestimate the main flow. A local velocity peak cannot represent whole-section flow; inspect the cross-sectional distribution.
units.misconception: 列車截面乘速度就是所有風井各自收到的相同流量~Train frontal area times speed is the identical flow received by every ventilation shaft.
units.practice: 將總排量分配到兩條假想阻力路徑，畫出質量守恆圖，再說明需要哪些壓差資料才能求分流比例。 再以本單元 train_area 的對照值重算 displacement_flow，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Divide the displacement among two hypothetical resistance paths, draw the mass balance, and identify the pressure measurements required to determine the split. Also recalculate displacement_flow for the alternative train_area value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 聲能相加與分貝~Sound-energy addition and decibels
units.title: 聲能相加與分貝~Sound-energy addition and decibels
units.mechanism: 分貝是對數量，兩個聲源不能直接把分貝數字相加。非相干聲源需先還原相對聲能再合成，頻帶、量測位置及時間加權若不同，表面上相同的數值也不能直接比較。 分貝是對數量，聲源互不相干時應先轉回線性能量再相加。頻率加權和量測時間必須相同，否則兩個數字不能直接合成；有相干干涉時還需相位資訊。 將曲線、牽引設備與背景噪音以聲能相加而非分貝相加。~Decibels are logarithmic, so sound levels cannot be added as ordinary numbers. Incoherent sources must first be converted to relative acoustic energy. Different bands, measurement positions or time weightings prevent direct comparison even when displayed values happen to match. Decibels are logarithmic, so incoherent sources must be converted to linear energy before summation. Frequency weighting and observation duration must match. Coherent interference additionally requires phase information and is not captured by the energy-sum model. Combine curve, traction-equipment and background noise by acoustic energy rather than by adding decibels.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：L1=71 dB; L2=67 dB；計算：combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=72.4554 dB。敏感度：L1 聲級增加 3 dB，不代表數值百分比的功率增加至 74 dB，其餘固定，結果為 74.7901 dB。模型邊界：相同基準與加權的非相干聲源；不含相位干涉與背景扣除。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: L1=71 dB; L2=67 dB; calculation: combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=72.4554 dB. Sensitivity: L1, increase the level by 3 dB, not a percentage increase in acoustic power, to 74 dB, with all other inputs fixed, gives 74.7901 dB. Model boundary: Incoherent sources with the same reference and weighting; phase interference and background subtraction are excluded.
units.verify: 同時保留背景、列車通過和設備單獨運轉紀錄，確認麥克風校正、距離與頻帶設定一致，避免把不同時間窗混合。 以聲級校正器檢查儀器前後漂移，記錄頻率加權和平均時間，再測背景聲單獨量級。~Retain background, train-passage and equipment-only recordings, confirm microphone calibration, distance and frequency settings, and avoid mixing incompatible time windows. Check instrument drift with a sound calibrator before and after measurement, record frequency weighting and averaging time, and measure background separately.
units.failure: 未扣除背景可能高估列車貢獻，錯用算術平均則低估高噪事件；屏障缺口還可能讓局部接收點明顯偏高。 若背景聲未扣除，不能把全部合成量歸因於列車。~Unremoved background can overstate train contribution, while arithmetic averaging understates loud events; barrier gaps can also produce local receiver hot spots. Without separate background measurement, the complete combined level cannot be attributed to the train.
units.misconception: 兩個七十分貝聲源同時工作一定產生一百四十分貝~Two seventy-decibel sources operating together necessarily produce one hundred forty decibels.
units.practice: 比較相同聲級與相差十分貝的兩聲源合成，列出背景扣除的適用條件，並解釋聲壓幅與聲能的對數係數差異。 再以本單元 L1 的對照值重算 combined，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Combine equal-level sources and sources ten decibels apart, list the conditions for background subtraction, and explain the different logarithmic factors for pressure amplitude and energy. Also recalculate combined for the alternative L1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 到站變異與平均等候~Arrival variability and mean waiting
units.title: 到站變異與平均等候~Arrival variability and mean waiting
units.mechanism: 當旅客隨機到站且不受容量限制時，平均等待與班距平方的期望值有關，長班距被更多旅客遇到。兩組平均班距相同的服務仍可能有不同等待時間，因此準點與均勻性具有獨立價值。 隨機到站旅客更容易遇到較長班距，因為長區間占較多時間，因此平均等候與班距變異數有關。公式假定旅客到達獨立於班表且每班可上車，不能表示服務櫃台或容量不足的隊列。 對抵達終端後隨機候車的旅客比較規則與不規則班距。~With random passenger arrivals and no capacity constraint, mean waiting depends on the expected squared headway. More passengers encounter longer gaps. Services with identical mean headway can therefore have different waiting times, giving regularity a value separate from the average frequency. Random arrivals encounter longer headways more often because those intervals occupy more time. Mean waiting therefore depends on headway variance. The formula assumes arrivals independent of the timetable and successful boarding on every train; it does not model counters or capacity-constrained queues. Compare regular and irregular headways for passengers who arrive randomly to wait at the terminal.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mean=187.2 s; sd=60 s；計算：wait=(mean**2+sd**2)/(2*mean)=103.2154 s。敏感度：mean 單獨增加百分之十至 205.92 s，其餘固定，結果為 111.7013 s。模型邊界：獨立隨機旅客到達、穩態班距且皆可登車；不含時刻表配合到站。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mean=187.2 s; sd=60 s; calculation: wait=(mean**2+sd**2)/(2*mean)=103.2154 s. Sensitivity: mean, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 205.92 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 111.7013 s. Model boundary: Random independent passenger arrivals, stationary headways and no denied boarding; timetable-aware arrivals are excluded.
units.verify: 從連續到站紀錄計算班距平均與變異數，再用匿名旅客到站時刻重播等待，檢查是否存在容量不足或非隨機到站。 從逐列到站時間重建班距平均與標準差，將旅客隨機到達事件重播，核對等候樣本平均。~Calculate headway mean and variance from consecutive arrivals, replay waiting with anonymous passenger arrival times, and check for capacity limits or nonrandom arrivals. Reconstruct mean and standard deviation from successive train arrivals, replay random passenger arrivals, and compare the sampled mean waiting time.
units.failure: 只報平均班距會低估不規則服務的等待；旅客配合時刻表到站時又不能直接套用隨機到站公式。 若滿載造成無法上車，需額外追蹤留下隊列而不能沿用公式。~Reporting only mean headway understates waiting under irregular service, while timetable-aware arrivals invalidate the random-arrival formula. When full trains prevent boarding, track the remaining queue separately instead of reusing this formula.
units.misconception: 兩組平均班距相同就一定有相同平均等候時間~Two services with equal mean headway necessarily have equal mean passenger waiting time.
units.practice: 保持平均班距不變，把標準差減半後重算等待，並用一組確定性到站時間說明公式假設何時失效。 再以本單元 mean 的對照值重算 wait，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Hold mean headway fixed and halve its standard deviation, recalculate waiting, then use deterministic arrivals to show when the formula assumptions fail. Also recalculate wait for the alternative mean value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 行李旅客與等效交換需求~Luggage and effective passenger exchange
units.title: 行李旅客與等效交換需求~Luggage and effective passenger exchange
units.mechanism: 機場旅客攜帶行李時占用更大空間且上下車較慢，可先以等效旅客係數整理交換需求。係數應由觀察校準而非固定刻板印象；門寬、坡差與同行群體又會改變通過時間。 等效需求把攜行李旅客依宣告係數換算為普通旅客負荷，不是把人數真的增加。係數需對應車門交換、通道占用等指定用途，不能拿一個值同時代表所有服務時間。 比較行李客群的等效車門交換需求，保留每人負荷係數。~Passengers with luggage often occupy more space and take longer to board, so an equivalent-passenger factor can organise exchange demand. It must be calibrated from observation rather than stereotypes. Door width, level differences and travelling groups also alter passage time. Equivalent demand converts baggage travellers into ordinary-passenger load using a declared factor; it does not create additional people. The factor must correspond to a specified purpose such as door exchange or space occupation, not represent all service times simultaneously. Compare equivalent doorway demand from baggage travellers while retaining the per-person load factor.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：plain=100 persons; luggage=62 persons; factor=1.6 equivalent/person；計算：equivalent_demand=plain+luggage*factor=199.2 equivalent persons。敏感度：luggage 將整數計數增加到 69至 69 persons，其餘固定，結果為 210.4 equivalent persons。模型邊界：線性加權的教學需求指標；不是正式容量標準或特定旅客評分。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: plain=100 persons; luggage=62 persons; factor=1.6 equivalent/person; calculation: equivalent_demand=plain+luggage*factor=199.2 equivalent persons. Sensitivity: luggage, increase the integer count to 69, to 69 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 210.4 equivalent persons. Model boundary: Linear teaching demand index; not a formal capacity standard or a rating of individual passengers.
units.verify: 匿名觀察不同門口的通過時間與行李尺寸群組，保留空間配置差異，避免把環境障礙全歸因於旅客行為。 分別計數一般旅客與行李旅客，以實測交換時間或占用面積校準係數，保留用途與區間。~Observe door passage times and luggage-size groups anonymously, retain layout differences, and avoid attributing environmental barriers entirely to passenger behaviour. Count ordinary and baggage passengers separately, calibrate the factor against exchange time or occupied area, and retain its purpose and range.
units.failure: 行李集中在少數車門會使全列停站時間由局部控制；同樣人數但不同分布可能造成完全不同的交換效率。 相同人數可能有不同負荷，需保留行李比例而非只報總人數。~Luggage clustering at a few doors can control whole-train dwell; the same passenger total with a different distribution can have very different exchange efficiency. Equal headcounts can impose different loads; retain baggage proportions rather than reporting total people only.
units.misconception: 機場列車只要乘客總數相同就一定具有相同停站需求~Airport trains with equal passenger totals necessarily have equal dwell demand.
units.practice: 比較集中行李區與分散行李區的等效需求，提出無障礙與一般旅客都可使用的導引方式，並列出需要實測校準的係數。 再以本單元 luggage 的對照值重算 equivalent_demand，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare concentrated and distributed luggage areas, propose guidance usable by passengers with different access needs, and list coefficients requiring measurement-based calibration. Also recalculate equivalent_demand for the alternative luggage value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 月台暫存與隊列守恆~Platform storage and queue conservation
units.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆~Platform storage and queue conservation
units.mechanism: 月台人數是進入、登車與離開人數的累積差，短時尖峰會使隊列成長，即使全天總運能足夠。可用面積應扣除樓梯口、設備與安全帶；密度只能描述平均狀態，不能單獨代表行人動態風險。 密度是人數除以有效面積，不直接描述人群流速或推擠力。設備、柱子及候車線會減少可用空間；安全通道應另列，不能為了降低平均密度而計入不可占用區域。 在終端候車區畫出排隊、移動與保留淨空的不同區域。~Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits. A short surge can grow a queue despite sufficient daily capacity. Usable area excludes stairs, equipment and safety strips. Density describes an average state but does not alone represent dynamic pedestrian risk. Density divides occupancy by usable area but does not directly describe walking speed or crowd pressure. Equipment, columns and waiting boundaries reduce usable space. Reserved circulation must be accounted separately, not included merely to lower the reported average density. Separate queueing, movement and reserved clear zones in the terminal waiting area.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=437 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.248571 persons/m^2。敏感度：people 將整數計數增加到 481至 481 persons，其餘固定，結果為 1.374286 persons/m^2。模型邊界：均勻平均密度；未含局部擠壓、行李和對向人流。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=437 persons; usable_area=350 m^2; calculation: density=people/usable_area=1.248571 persons/m^2. Sensitivity: people, increase the integer count to 481, to 481 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.374286 persons/m^2. Model boundary: Uniform average density; local compression, luggage and opposing streams are excluded.
units.verify: 用匿名計數器核對入口、出口與登車量，分區觀察月台密度，保留列車延誤時間以辨認隊列成長來源。 以分區影片計數核對總人數，量測淨面積，並同時記錄局部瓶頸及進出流量。~Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow. Cross-check total occupancy with zonal video counts, measure net area, and record local bottlenecks and entry-exit flows simultaneously.
units.failure: 平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 總平均密度低仍可能局部壅塞，須查看門口與樓梯區域。~A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. Low overall mean density can coexist with local crowding; inspect doorway and stair zones.
units.misconception: 只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞~Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.
units.practice: 模擬一列取消後兩個班距內的人數變化，扣除不能站立的面積，提出分流措施並比較它們改變的是流量還是暫存容量。 再以本單元 people 的對照值重算 density，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Simulate population for two headways after one cancellation, subtract unusable area, and compare whether proposed controls change flow rate or storage capacity. Also recalculate density for the alternative people value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 折返作業與路徑占用~Turnback and route occupation
units.title: 折返作業與路徑占用~Turnback and route occupation
units.mechanism: 終端折返的限制可能來自進站清空、換端、道岔鎖閉或離站衝突。將事件畫成時間線才能分辨能平行的任務與必須串接的任務；簡單加總是一條明示串聯路徑，不是所有終端的通用最小班距。 只要有兩條路徑共享道岔或保護區，表面上分開的月台仍可能互相限制。時序模型應包含占用開始、列車清空和進路釋放三個不同時間，而非一個站停數字。 把終端進路清空與旅客下車完成分開，找出串聯瓶頸。~A terminus may be constrained by approach clearance, cab change, point locking or conflicting departure routes. An event timeline separates parallel tasks from mandatory serial tasks. A simple sum represents one declared serial path, rather than a universal minimum headway for every terminal layout. Platforms that appear separate can still constrain each other through shared points or protection zones. A sequence model needs distinct times for occupation, physical clearance and route release rather than representing all three by one station dwell value. Separate route clearance from completion of alighting to identify serial bottlenecks.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：arrival=35 s; reverse=78 s; release=25 s；計算：cycle=arrival+reverse+release=138 s。敏感度：reverse 單獨增加百分之十至 85.8 s，其餘固定，結果為 145.8 s。模型邊界：單一折返路徑且三項活動不可重疊；不含備用月台與延誤恢復。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: arrival=35 s; reverse=78 s; release=25 s; calculation: cycle=arrival+reverse+release=138 s. Sensitivity: reverse, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 85.8 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 145.8 s. Model boundary: One turnback route with three nonoverlapping activities; spare platforms and delay recovery are excluded.
units.verify: 把軌道占用、道岔位置與駕駛換端紀錄放在同一時間軸，逐項檢查是否存在未被模型表示的互斥條件。 用占用指示與實際尾端清空時間互證，並列出各活動能否平行及其必要前置事件。~Place track occupation, point position and cab-change logs on one timeline, then identify exclusion conditions omitted by the simplified sequence. Cross-check occupation indication against actual rear-end clearance and list whether each task can overlap and which preceding events it requires.
units.failure: 只縮短換端時間而未解除路徑衝突，未必能縮短班距；錯把進路解鎖時間當成列車清空時間也會低估占用。 若尾端尚未清空，不能以換端完成取代進路釋放證據。~Reducing cab-change time cannot remove an unresolved route conflict; confusing route release with physical clearance also understates occupation time. Cab-change completion cannot substitute for route-release evidence while the train rear remains uncleared.
units.misconception: 換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數~Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway.
units.practice: 畫出單月台與雙月台折返的甘特圖，標註不可同時使用的路徑，並以一班晚到列車檢查延誤是否傳到下一班。 再以本單元 reverse 的對照值重算 cycle，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Draw single-platform and dual-platform turnback timelines, mark mutually exclusive routes, and introduce one late train to test propagation into the next departure. Also recalculate cycle for the alternative reverse value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 互斥進路與真值驗證~Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
units.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證~Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
units.mechanism: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。狀態數隨布林輸入快速增加，真值表可檢查邏輯完整性，但不能代替時序與硬體故障分析。 布林組合數表示測試狀態空間的大小，並不代表每個狀態在現場都可達或安全。應把占用、道岔鎖閉和授權的邏輯關係明列，逐項證明危險組合會被拒絕。 檢查進出終端同時請求進路時的互鎖拒絕條件。~Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. Occupancy, locked points and complete train passage jointly determine permissive conditions. Boolean input combinations grow rapidly; a truth table checks logical coverage but does not replace timing analysis or hardware fault assessment. The Boolean count describes the size of a test state space, not that every state is reachable or safe in service. Explicitly state relations among occupation, point locking and authority, and demonstrate that hazardous combinations are rejected. Check interlocking refusal conditions when arrivals and departures request routes simultaneously.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=8 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=256 states。敏感度：inputs 增加 1 個布林輸入至 9 Boolean inputs，其餘固定，結果為 512 states。模型邊界：有限個獨立二值輸入的完整枚舉；不代表實際聯鎖軟體測試已完成。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=8 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=256 states. Sensitivity: inputs, add one Boolean input, to 9 Boolean inputs, with all other inputs fixed, gives 512 states. Model boundary: Complete enumeration of independent binary inputs; not a claim that real interlocking software has been tested.
units.verify: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 從真值表逐列執行故障注入，記錄預期拒絕與實際輸出，並覆核非法狀態不可授權。~Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Execute fault injection row by row from the truth table, recording expected refusal and actual output, and verify that illegal states receive no authority.
units.failure: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 狀態覆蓋率高仍可能缺少危險轉移，須查事件先後。~Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. High state coverage can still miss a hazardous transition; inspect event ordering as well.
units.misconception: 聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求~Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
units.practice: 為兩條衝突進路建立真值表，標記禁止組合，再加入先占用後解鎖的事件序列，說明組合邏輯和時序邏輯的差異。 再以本單元 inputs 的對照值重算 combinations，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Build a truth table for two conflicting routes, mark forbidden combinations, then add occupancy and release event sequences to distinguish combinational from temporal logic. Also recalculate combinations for the alternative inputs value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 延遲與制動距離~Delay and braking distance
units.title: 延遲與制動距離~Delay and braking distance
units.mechanism: 列車在控制命令傳遞與煞車建立期間仍向前行駛，減速段才把動能耗散；因此停車距離包含延遲距離與減速距離。速度平方項說明高速時少量速度誤差會被放大，固定減速度只能作第一輪界限估算。 延遲項與速度成正比，減速項與速度平方成正比；把兩項分開後，才能選擇改善控制延遲或增加有效制動的方案。若存在坡度，應另加沿坡重力，不能只改總距離。 將高速降速段與終端低速停止分成不同制動工況。~A train continues moving while the command propagates and brake force builds. Only the deceleration phase removes kinetic energy, so stopping distance includes both a delay term and a braking term. The squared speed dependence amplifies speed uncertainty; constant deceleration is only an initial bounding approximation. The delay term is linear in speed and the deceleration term is quadratic. Separating them reveals whether control latency or effective braking deserves attention. A gradient requires an added gravitational component, not an arbitrary adjustment to the final distance. Separate high-speed deceleration from the final low-speed terminal stop.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=72.8 m/s; delay=2.5 s; a=0.7 m/s^2；計算：distance=v*delay+v*v/(2*a)=3967.6 m。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 80.08 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 4780.776 m。模型邊界：水平直線、定減速、無風；沒有建立黏著分布與煞車熱衰退。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=72.8 m/s; delay=2.5 s; a=0.7 m/s^2; calculation: distance=v*delay+v*v/(2*a)=3967.6 m. Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 80.08 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 4780.776 m. Model boundary: Level straight track and constant deceleration; adhesion variation and thermal fade are excluded.
units.verify: 對齊速度、煞車缸壓力與里程的時間戳，分開辨識命令延遲及穩態減速度，再以積分速度的距離交叉檢查。 用獨立里程或地速核對輪速積分，報告濕乾軌差異及停車距離的重複試驗範圍。~Align speed, brake-cylinder pressure and distance timestamps. Identify command delay separately from steady deceleration and cross-check distance by integrating measured speed. Check integrated wheel speed against independent distance or ground speed, and report wet-dry differences and repeated stopping-distance ranges.
units.failure: 輪滑保護介入與濕軌會降低實際減速度；感測時間不同步也能製造假延遲，須以第二個時鐘和輪速紀錄區分。 應比較壓力建立與地速下降先後，避免誤判煞車故障。~Wheel-slide protection and wet rails can reduce deceleration; unsynchronised sensors can imitate a delay, requiring an independent clock and wheel-speed records. Compare pressure build-up with ground-speed decay before diagnosing a brake fault.
units.misconception: 速度增加一成時制動距離必定也只增加一成~A ten percent speed increase must increase braking distance by only ten percent.
units.practice: 分別增加延遲與初速，畫出兩條停車曲線；寫出哪個區段對各參數敏感，以及需要哪些現場資料才可建立保護曲線。 再以本單元 v 的對照值重算 distance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase delay and initial speed separately, plot both stopping curves, identify the sensitive phase, and list the field evidence needed before defining a protection curve. Also recalculate distance for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 可用度與修復時間~Availability and repair time
units.title: 可用度與修復時間~Availability and repair time
units.mechanism: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。 平均故障間隔和平均修復時間必須使用相同服務邊界；備件等待與到場時間若被排除，數字就不能描述旅客看到的中斷。短期樣本也應報告事件數與觀測時間。 把基礎設施可用與旅客處理服務可用分別列出。~In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved. Spares, travel and diagnosis all affect actual restoration time. Mean time between failures and mean repair time require a common service boundary. Excluding spare-part waiting or travel time prevents the figure from describing passenger-visible interruption. Short samples should also report event count and observation duration. Report infrastructure availability separately from availability of passenger-processing services.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1248 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968051 1。敏感度：mtbf 單獨增加百分之十至 1372.8 h，其餘固定，結果為 0.9970947 1。模型邊界：兩狀態穩態平均模型；不含計畫維修、共同原因與降級服務品質。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1248 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968051 1. Sensitivity: mtbf, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1372.8 h, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.9970947 1. Model boundary: Two-state steady-state mean model; planned maintenance, common causes and degraded service quality are excluded.
units.verify: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。~Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours.
units.failure: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。~Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints.
units.misconception: 設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低~High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.
units.practice: 比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
